Callout.Name: Fight in a Pool Hall
Callout.Message: Fight in a pool hall, one person with a cue.

Script.Line: He fouled me on the table and then he laughed about it.
The cue is mine. I brought it in with me.
Ask the man behind the bar. He saw all of it.

Lines.Approach: Four of them and one has a cue. Get in there before it becomes something else.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
